spanish: Hiriente de varón, y muere, de morir morirá.

findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 3ms (he is put to death) is rendered as intransitive morirá (he will die), changing stem force.

notes: Hiriente de varón matches the hiphil participle with varón; y muere matches the qal sequential; de morir matches the qal infinitive absolute.
